speaker: charlie
text: Right, onto the sports, and what a weekend it's been for underdogs making their mark. Georgia Tech absolutely stunned Oklahoma in the NCAA baseball regional final, with the Yellow Jackets posting their first 2-0 regional start in 16 years. The Sooners had rolled past Citadel 15-5 earlier, scoring 14 runs in just three innings, but couldn't handle Tech when it mattered.

speaker: alice
text: College baseball's been absolutely bonkers this tournament - walk-offs, upsets, extra innings, you name it. Liberty also pulled off a beauty, coming back from 2-0 down to beat Boston College 8-3 and earn themselves a rematch against Georgia. Meanwhile, over in Europe, Barcelona fans voted their Clasico victory and league title as the best moment of May.

speaker: charlie
text: And here's a fun one from the NFL - Shedeur Sanders, the young quarterback, has just kicked Tom Brady's butt in some sort of marketplace competition. The lad's got his own LLC called 'SS2Legendary' which shows he's thinking big picture. Sometimes sport's as much about the business side as what happens on the field, especially these days.
